title: IMPRINT Reels
subtitle: for UBC IMPRINT
summary: A run of reels for UBC Imprint Conference & Competition, where I'm VP Content Marketing. The first three tease After Hours on 20 October 2026. More land over the next few weeks.

body.heading: The brief
body.text: Make people want to show up to After Hours on 20 October without telling them much about it. Three reels, zero spoilers. The first rule of After Hours, as the caption says, you already know.

body.heading: Ep. 01 · After Hours
body.text: Shot and cut as a short film teaser, opening on a title card that reads “a film by Ilyas Ishenaliev”. If you're going to make a reel, you might as well credit yourself like it's Cannes. Red type, dark rooms, two people who clearly know something you don't.

body.heading: Ep. 02 · After Hours, Pt. 2
body.text: Same mood, new set. Someone walks toward a wall of gothic arched doors under red neon script, and nobody explains anything. That's the point.

body.heading: Ep. 03 · After Hours, Pt. 3
body.text: Made with ACE UBC. The colour drains to black and white, the cast gets bigger, and someone grins through a phone call in front of a laptop while a wall of tuxedo portraits watches on. Still no explanation.

body.heading: What's next
body.text: More episodes are on the way. They get added here as they're posted.
